verdict.rationale: uv is a local Python package and project manager CLI. It holds no production data and exposes no hosted service with separate sandbox and production tiers, so testing against a sandbox to protect production data is a category error for this product. Its isolated ephemeral tool environments (uvx) isolate dependencies, not data. That is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
